A.targets: Same primary matched-temperature targets as saved static tests; CALCE audit all four25C profiles using existing audit_rows priority rules; never force source z0=.8.
A.simulation: Reuse exp_lfp_static.predict at1s with continuous states, zero initial RC, positive-discharge current, fixed independent/checkpoint OCV; all original metrics and masks.
A.V1: Reuse saved source V1 parameters, no refit; per-profile documented/audited z0.
A.V6-Q: Fit only Qratio,z0 on source, RC fixed at saved V1. Qratio[.9,1.1],z0[.9,1]. Transfer fitted Q/z0 unchanged.
A.V6-RC: Fit five log RC coordinates only on source; measured Qreference and per-profile documented/audited z0 fixed. Same mathematical parameterization as V1; report numerical agreement or local-minimum differences, not independent causal evidence.
A.V6: Reuse saved joint source fits including local A123 V6 diagnostics; no refit.
A.V6-wide: CALCE only, joint RC/Q/z0 source NLS with z0[.7,1],Qratio[.9,1.1]. Source audit is documented; transfer fitted z0, Q, RC unchanged to audited target cycles. Baseline V1 uses audited target z0. POSITIVE iff MAEwide<=.75 MAEV1 in all DST/US06/BJDST25.
A.thermal: A123 source25 fits transfer to FUDS/US06 at0/10/40/50. Local V6-Q fits each localDST but RC remains V1DST25, Qreference=measuredQ25; local V6-RC fits localDST with Q25 and z0=1 fixed. V6 local reused. V1 baseline remains saved transferredDST25 for both thermal blocks.
A.V6-OCVT: A123 local only: joint V6 fit on localDST with own-temperature low-current OCV from existing load_temperature/build_curves; Qreference remains Q25 to isolate OCV substitution, Qratio[.9,1.1],z0[.9,1]. Never use FUDS/US06 to select.
A.optimizer: Original TRF linear least_squares, x_scale=jac,max_nfev500,ftol/xtol/gtol1e-8; same3original starts projected to free coordinates; V6-Q uses Q/z0 starts only with fixedRCV1; wide uses originalz0 starts1,.95,.9; select lowest sourceSSE among converged starts. No converged start=>explicit inconclusive, never score failedtheta.
A.fraction: (MAEV1-MAEvariant)/(MAEV1-MAEV6), signed/unclipped. Exactlyzero denominator=>null with warning. Nonpositive V6gain reported but excluded mechanism attribution.
A.interpretation: Strict majority (>half) of positive-V6gain conditions separately in matched-temperature, thermal-transfer, thermal-local blocks; also per-cell matched-temperature descriptive counts. SOC if Qfraction>=.7 majority only; RC if RCfraction>=.7 majority only; both or neither=>conjunto. No positivegain eligible=>inconclusive. Missing fits prevent complete-block claim.
A.outputs: results/param_ablation complete fits/attempts/hash manifests, per-condition/stratum metrics, trajectorynpz, tables and interpretation

B.conditions: 18principal original continuous conditions excluding CALCE US06/BJDST25 fallback; do not insert corrected target results into this registered family.
B.tests: Reuse exact shifted_wilcoxon from exp_paper_v2_seeds: roundshifted d10decimals,dropzeros,averageabsolute tiedranks,enumerate2^n signs; lowerd+1 greater,upperd-1 less; allzero p1. Holm18 separately pair/direction. Both adjustedp<.05 equivalence.
B.estimand: Signed-rank location/pseudomedian under symmetry; report paired-difference median AND Hodges-Lehmann Walsh-average pseudomedian, distinguish descriptive median from statisticWplus. No confidence interval implied by seedrange.
B.bootstrap_audit: Read exact existing implementation: resample10pairedseed differences LSTMminusdeterministic2RC,20000replacementdraws,median each,percentile2.5/97.5,RNG20261101; no temporal resampling.

C.histories: Read80savedmodel/dataset/seed histories, selected epoch from checkpoint summary, executedepochs=historylength, final train/val from last historyepoch (not selectedweight loss); also selected-epoch losses.
C.figures: One vectorPDF permodel/dataset, width3.5in,Times>=8pt,nointernaltitle,mediantrain/validation and minmax only among runs observed at each epoch; no forwardfill after earlystop, report nper epoch; no newtraining.
C.code_audit: Ground NLS source interval, normalization I/V/T/SOC, loss, optimizer/scheduler, integrator states and dt, bounds/tolerances/maxevaluations/starts in exact effective source and saved provenance; report code line citations and filehashes.

protocol.V1_OCV: Exact degree-5 Chebyshev OCV from read-only unified Panasonic 2RC checkpoint; identified on source training windows, NOT an independent low-current OCV. User confirmed.
protocol.z0_V1_V5: 1.0 for all profiles, as unified protocol; no target voltage inversion.
protocol.soc: Canonical net Ah = negative raw Ah, offset at first retained sample; causal z0-net_Ah/2.9, clipped only in OCV evaluation.

calce.label: calce

ocv.method: SP1 independent 25C 0.05C discharge; trapezoidal current integration, Qnom=2Ah, z0=1; 0.002 SOC median bins; monotonic cumulative maximum
ocv.limitation: low-current OCV approximation, different cell; fixed 25C curve reused zero-shot at all temperatures
ocv.duplicate_policy: Preserve rows as unified calibration; zero-dt intervals integrate zero Ah.
ocv.interpolation: PCHIP V(SOC); hold at measured support

protocol.V1_OCV: SP1 independent 25C low-current discharge step 3, Q=2Ah, trapezoidal integration; same 0.002 SOC median bins and cumulative-maximum denoising as unified, PCHIP voltage(SOC), boundary hold at measured support.
protocol.z0_V1_V5: Reuse each profile's documented causal initial SOC from read-only unified summary, with raw-file hash verification; no new target fitting.
protocol.z0_V6_V7: Keep requested [0.9,1.0] even though SP2 80SOC source starts near 0.82. Transfer source-fitted z0 unchanged to all targets. User confirmed this incompatibility must be disclosed.
protocol.soc: Step 7 only, canonical net Ah = Discharge_Capacity minus Charge_Capacity offset at first sample, preserving regeneration; no discharge-only counter or end normalization.
